attchmntText: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Limited has disclosed a schedule of analyst and institutional investor meetings under SEBI LODR regulations. Meetings are scheduled from November 16, 2026, to November 18, 2026, in Taiwan and Singapore, and on November 23, 2026, in Switzerland. The Taiwan and Singapore events are physical one-on-one meetings, while the Switzerland event is a physical group meeting. The company states that no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during these sessions. The schedule may change due to exigencies. This intimation is filed with the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited.

attchmntText: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Limited has uploaded the transcript of its earnings call held on November 06, 2026, for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The transcript is available on the company website at https://glenmark.b-cdn.net/gpl_pdfs/Financials/Quarterly/Glenmark-Earnings-Nov06-2026.pdf. This filing is pursuant to Regulation 30(6) read with Part A of Schedule III of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015. The document was submitted to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited on November 09, 2026. The submission follows a previous letter dated October 23, 2026. The company requests the exchanges to take the transcript on record.
